xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesToAnnexure1Ex: Effective from the December 2025 quarter, this Integrated Compliance Report marks the first submission to the Board of Directors.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: Order for adjudication of penalty under Section 454 of the Companies Act, 2013 (‘the Act’) for violation of section 135(7) of the Companies Act, 2013.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: For the FY 2020-21 the company had CSR obligations of INR. 14,79,394 which the company failed to spend in the prescribed timelines. Hence, there is violation of section 135(5) of the Act for FY 2020-21 and 2021-22 for which the company and its officers in default are liable for penalty under section 135(7) of the Act.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: There is no impact on financials or operational activities of the Company on account of the aforesaid order.
